2607.05355.title: Faithfulness to Refusal: A Causal Audit of Neuron Selectors
2607.05355.paper_summary: Attribution scores increasingly identify which neuron rows of a language model matter for applications such as pruning, interpretability, and editing for safety, yet whether they identify causally important rows is rarely tested directly. We address this with two paired audits built on one-shot neuron-row zeroing. We first audit selectors at the language-modeling level: attribution methods substantially outperform activation and magnitude-based baselines at identifying dispensable rows across five LLMs. We then adapt the same intervention into a behavior test by driving it with a contrastive harmful-versus-benign signal; the attributed rows are sufficient to install refusal on hate and crime while keeping benign over-refusal low and preserving language model fluency, and specific in that layer-matched random controls at the same depths fail. Highly rank-stable selectors can be among the least causally valid. Refusal moreover lives in a redundant subspace, where different attribution methods install it through largely disjoint row sets, so the recovered edit is one realization of a sufficient set rather than a unique mechanism. Together, these findings show that rank-stability proxies miss the kinds of selector failures a direct causal audit can surface.%
2607.05355.paper_summary_zh: 歸因分數越來越能識別語言模型中哪些神經元行對於修剪、可解釋性和安全編輯等應用是重要的，但它們是否能識別出因果上重要的行卻很少被直接測試。我們通過兩個基於一次性神經元行歸零的配對審計來解決這個問題。我們首先在語言建模層面上審計選擇器：在識別五個大型語言模型中的可有可無行方面，歸因方法顯著優於基於激活和幅度的基準。我們然後將相同的干預措施轉化為行為測試，通過對比有害與良性信號來驅動它；所歸因的行足以在保持良性過度拒絕低且保留語言模型流暢性的同時，對仇恨和犯罪進行拒絕，而在相同深度的層匹配隨機控制中則失敗。高度穩定的選擇器可能是因果有效性最低的。拒絕此外存在於一個冗餘的子空間中，不同的歸因方法通過大體上不相交的行集來實現它，因此恢復的編輯是一組充分集的實現，而不是唯一的機制。總的來說，這些發現表明，排名穩定性代理錯過了直接因果審計可以揭示的選擇器失效類型。
